web.title: Iran-Aligned Volant Manticore Uses IPFS-Based KuboShell Backdoor in Espionage Campaigns
web.description: A previously undocumented Iran-aligned cyber espionage group called Volant Manticore  has targeted telecommunications companies, airlines, and critical infrastructure in Cyprus.   Central to the group's operations  is a backdoor called KuboShell that uses the InterPlanetary File System ( IPFS ) for command-and-control (C2) and deploys Homa, a post-compromise framework that's a reimplementation of MuddyWater's MuddyC2Go . Evidence indicates that the threat actor has been operational since late August 2025.   Also delivered alongside these tools are Remote Monitoring and Management (RMM) programs like MeshCentral and NetLock RMM. In tandem, the group has been observed orchestrating credential harvesting campaigns to collect email and corporate credentials of some of the impersonated organizations.
